name: Onesimus
summary: A man from among the Colossian believers who had once served Philemon and became like a son to Paul while Paul was in chains. Paul sent him back, asking Philemon to welcome him as a beloved brother.

key_moments.title: Sent with Tychicus
key_moments.description: Paul sent Onesimus, a trusted, dearly loved brother who was one of the Colossians' own, along with Tychicus. Together they would tell the church all that was happening with Paul.

key_moments.title: No Longer Just a Servant
key_moments.description: Paul pleaded with Philemon for Onesimus, who had become like a son to Paul in his chains and was now useful where once he was useless. Paul sent him back, asking Philemon to receive him as a beloved brother, as he would receive Paul himself, and to charge any debt to Paul.
